instructions: Combine the chopped meat, onions, salt, and pepper.
Use a wet paper towel to dampen the dumpling wrappers.
Fill each dumpling wrapper with about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture and seal the dumpling.
Place the filled dumplings on a tray lined with nonstick aluminum foil and freeze.
When ready to cook, bring water to a boil in the steamer and add about 1 tablespoon of salt to the boiling water.
Place the frozen dumplings in the steamer trays and steam for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Transfer to a plate and spray a little oil on each mante. Serve and enjoy!
notes: Family recipe from a photo of a handwritten page (signed "Babanina"). The dumplings are filled, frozen, then steamed straight from frozen. Prep time, cook time, and servings are estimated: the source gives no servings, and the 45–60 minute steam is the cook time. The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of steamed manti with yogurt.

tips.text: The filled dumplings go straight from the freezer into the steamer, so make a big batch and freeze what you don't cook right away.
tips.title: Freeze first, steam later

tips.text: The recipe calls for a steamer with trays — the dumplings steam from frozen for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
tips.title: You'll need a steamer
